evidence.locator: Lab choices 442/862 option 0 reject the ICEbreaker and converge on exact q304_songbirds_path=1 at scene node 81. The q304 deal phase reaches lab_done only after the Songbird wake continuation returns. Parent main graph routes this positive branch to q306. This establishes save-recorded history, including initialized history, not who physically selected a button.

Lab choices 442/862 option 1 use the ICEbreaker. q304 deal phase enters gender-specific ReplacerSwitchEndMaleReed/FemaleReed entries; scene starts 1832/1837 write q304_alex_dead=1 at 2653/4900. V accuses Songbird after Alex is killed; Reed confirms the ICEbreaker over comms. q304_lab_done is written on the completed Reed exit. Alex death is not inferred from songbirds_path=0.

Finale choice 604 (and the equivalent 7/328/737/931 choices) grants Songbird request; the dying dialogue precedes exact q305_fact_songbird_dead=1. Reed appears after the decision and addresses the already dead Songbird. Core phase scene End 0 reaches journal q305_bunker Succeeded. No later NUSA handover is inferred here.

Finale choice 604 options 1/2 and equivalent choices refuse the request to die and converge on exact q305_songbird_alive=1 at 659; Songbird participates in this conversation. Core phase marks q305_bunker Succeeded after the finale. Alive is an explicit positive write, not the absence of a death flag; neither Myers custody nor V surgery is inferred.

Launchpad phase invokes the real standoff_start entry of q306_10_finale. The shot reaction reaches exact q306_reed_killed=1, and Reed_Dead_Out leads to the Moon resolution entry. The lunar rocket ending writes q306_launchpad_done=1. Reed-takes-Songbird and the separate player-retreat resolution both write q306_somi_betrayed=1 and launchpad_done=1. Thus the latter means custody, not a unique surrender button. Johnny speaks during the lunar resolution; Songbird is unconscious and cannot automatically know Reed final words.

q306_finale_deal_done=1 has multiple valid writers: explicit cure bargains in the monorail/finale; acceptance of Reed later text after retreat; and q306_deal_denied/02_ch_v_answers/02_alright after an earlier refusal. The epilogue accepted-choice Succeeded condition (node 66) leads through Reed reply and objective completion to writer 54. Root main quest node 35 tests the flag before enabling q307. q306_finale_deal_no_drug is a historical stance and can coexist with a later accepted offer. Rule therefore requires actual NCX custody and asserts only a recorded arrangement, not launchpad choice or completed surgery.

Nele finale option 59:0 and subsequent surrender paths lead to exact sts_ep1_07_nele_captured=1 at scene 1560. The separate final-gameplay phase also sets it after V withdraws, so this fact cannot establish an explicit surrender choice. The main gig phase node 371 receives Succeeded on the normal completion path. Rule states custody with unknown method and leaves her subsequent fate unresolved.

Final-gameplay phase sets sts_ep1_07_all_agents_defeated=1 after all corporate agents are defeated, unconscious or killed; it does not prove all died. Its all-killed output invokes the Nele-thanks scene entry and activates the final talk_with_nele objective. Friendly and angry return-shard choices converge on nele_thanks_end, which marks that objective Succeeded. This verifies protection and departure, not a friendly farewell.

mq306_03_expo_ripper is Aaron Waines story, not Aaron McCarlson. Choice 179:0 enters section 181 then exact mq306_dive=1; choice 179:1 enters section 182 then exact mq306_fight_clean=1. Aaron responds to V directly. These are mutually exclusive advice branches after intimidation, not already played boxing outcomes. Finale texts are separately gated.

The normal Aaron follow-up phase selects the dive text via the fight_clean comparator, activates 01a_aaron_dive, waits for a V reply, then activates 03a_aaron_disgraced. The actual shipped English text for 85239 reports throwing the match and 85245 reports leaving boxing and successfully coaching Dogtown children. Both exact phone entries must be revealed in the current save; advice flags alone cannot activate this later fate.

The normal Aaron follow-up phase fight_clean comparator selects 01b_aaron_fight_clean, waits for V reply, then activates 03b_aaron_abroad. Shipped English 85240 reports an honest tenth-round knockout loss; 85246 reports reaching Costa Rica and earning a living through street fights by his own choice. Require both revealed phone messages and the matching positive advice flag, not a generic quest completion or a future intention.

Clinic choice 78:0 accepts Angies arrangement and reaches mq306_angie_path=1; choice 78:3 threatens her with the Sasquatch example and writes mq306_intimidate=1 after section 91. Aaron is unconscious for this negotiation. Its details therefore require an explicit V disclosure to Aaron, rather than treating him as an eyewitness. No mq306_animals_dead rule is used: that flag can mean opponents defeated, including unconscious, rather than Angie literally killed.

The actual q305 border phase calls q305_11_border_crossing. Put-down choices 112/114 converge on 848 then handover section 3187. Its completion socket reaches 7856 with journal input ordinal 3 (Succeeded) for 07_place_corpse_on_stretcher, followed by the observe objective. The internal corpse label is shared across both fate branches; neither that label nor the Less/Greater comparator alone proves death. Pair the reached handover objective with the separately proved positive core alive/dead write. Reed and NUSA agents participate in the transfer. This proves custody/body delivery, not recovery, permission, a particular cure promise, or the cause of death. Alternate selectors 2024/2081 receive only Active ordinal 1 from 2029/2034; they do not independently establish completed handover.

Border choice 131 options 0 and 1 explicitly take the medal and each positively write q305_11_medal_taken=1 at 4661. Option 2 refuses without that writer; zero or absence does not establish refusal. Later exact comparisons at 15125/15130 branch the medal discussion. Runtime additionally requires the reached alive handover. The conservative audience requires V to disclose acceptance to Reed, rather than equating his awareness of the offer with knowledge of V accepting.

Reed holocall choice 39 options 0/2 affirm readiness and the accepted dialogue reaches exact q307_call_reed_confirmed=1 at 108. The mutable q307_ready and sticky refusal fact are not used as final fate proof. The actual pickup phase Enter choices 32 options 0/1/2 converge on the boarding chain, including doctor-mounted 390, agent-mounted 388, player-mounted 398, AV doors closed 71, and delay 89. Then 213 receives Succeeded input ordinal 3 for 04_enter_av and 215 activates travel to the clinic. Runtime requires both the accepted call and reached boarding objective, plus a proved eligible Songbird route. This means acceptance and boarding for treatment, not completed surgery, two-year coma, Relic removal, or later implant restrictions. Initial readiness alone remains insufficient. The alternate enter-AV selector 209 receives only Active ordinal 1 from 208; it does not prove boarding.

Shipped normal EP1 definition schedules ep1.quest; normal graph and parent phase connections qualify q303 nighthawks and q306 Alex epilogue. Standalone/debug definitions do not substitute for normal production scheduling.

Exact back-with-Reed=1 receipt plus succeeded talk-Reed-and-Alex objective; normal scene in reaches both. Success ordinal3 comes from wrap-up section5338, and that section is structurally necessary for the normal success path. Debug silverhand success alone has no paired receipt.

rules.statement: The saved story records V helping Songbird through the stadium lab operation.
The saved story records V attempting to incapacitate Songbird during the stadium lab operation. Songbird directly experienced the attempted capture.

The saved stadium outcome records Alex's death during the ICEbreaker branch. A managed Alex copy does not change that canonical outcome. This account is available here only after V has disclosed it to this listener.
At the conclusion of the Cynosure core scene, Reed arrived to find Songbird dead. This observation does not make him an eyewitness to her preceding private exchange with V.
V complied with Songbird's request to die at the Cynosure core. This is the canonical saved outcome, disclosed by V to this listener; a spawned copy does not undo the death.
At the Cynosure core, V refused Songbird's request to die and kept her alive. The later NUSA handover and any operation on V remain separate events.

The NCX launchpad sequence ended with Reed dead and Songbird sent away on the lunar shuttle. Johnny witnessed and discussed this outcome. Her subsequent medical recovery is not established by the launch.

V has disclosed that Reed died at NCX and Songbird left aboard the lunar shuttle. Songbird was unconscious for the confrontation, and neither she nor Alex receives Reed's exact last exchange as firsthand memory.

The NCX sequence ended with Reed taking Songbird alive into FIA custody. This evidence does not identify whether V explicitly handed her over or withdrew, and does not by itself establish a cure agreement.

The saved NCX aftermath records an accepted arrangement for Reed to help secure treatment for V. The agreement may have been accepted after the confrontation by message. It establishes neither a completed operation nor its result.
V defeated the corporate team, spoke with Nele afterward, and let her leave. This outcome does not establish that the attackers all died or that the farewell was friendly.
The completed gig records Nele being taken into Biotechnica custody. The evidence does not distinguish explicit surrender from V withdrawing, and does not reveal her later fate.
V has disclosed that Nele was taken into Biotechnica custody after the gig. The exact surrender or withdrawal sequence and her subsequent fate remain unconfirmed.
After Angie's withdrawal, V advised Aaron to throw the bout as the safer choice. This advice alone does not establish what later happened in the ring or to his career.
After Angie's withdrawal, V encouraged Aaron to fight honestly instead of deliberately losing. The advice does not itself guarantee victory or safety.

Aaron reported throwing the match, then leaving competitive boxing and finding satisfying work coaching young people in Dogtown. These are his actual later reports in this save, not a prediction from V's earlier advice.
Aaron reported losing the honest bout by knockout in the tenth round. In a later message he said he had reached Costa Rica and was earning money in street fights on a path he chose himself.

V has disclosed accepting Angie's arrangement while Aaron was unconscious at the clinic. Aaron did not witness the negotiation itself; this establishes the agreement, not that the later bout has already happened.
V has disclosed driving Angie away at the clinic with a threat invoking Sasquatch. Aaron was unconscious during that exchange and cannot quote it as firsthand experience.
This save records that Songbird survived Cynosure and V completed the border handover to NUSA custody with Reed. Her later condition and recovery are not established by that transfer.
This save records that Songbird was dead at Cynosure and V completed delivery of her body to the NUSA at the border with Reed. This observation does not reveal the private cause or her last request.
V has told Reed that V accepted the medal Myers offered after returning Songbird alive. Acceptance of the object does not prove political loyalty, gratitude, or agreement with Myers.
This save records that V accepted the FIA treatment arrangement with Reed and boarded the FIA transport for treatment. The operation and its eventual outcome are not yet established by these records.
This save records that V accepted the FIA treatment arrangement with Reed and boarded the FIA transport for treatment. The operation and its eventual outcome are not yet established by these records.

This save records V meeting Alex at the Moth with Reed and completing their discussion. Alex learned that Reed was still alive. This establishes their operational first contact, without implying later friendship or romance.

V completed a later private farewell with the living Alex at the Moth. Alex disclosed that her last assignment was to eliminate V, but said she was content to let the Relic illness take its course. This encounter does not establish that V has died or that Alex has already retired.

During the completed farewell, this save records V giving Alex the presidential coin. She accepted the keepsake. This does not establish a romance, a later postcard, or a separate decision to retain the coin.
